test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many such pairs of letters are there in the word REGULATION (in the forward direction) which have as many letters between them in the word as there are in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
**Given:**

REGULATION 

**Concept:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

**Explanation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/060fcb74af06ce7a29009c1f052487ef946be88d8b7e2c18d27dc67b39f7516a.png] 

There are two such pairs in alphabetical order (**GN**) and (**RU**)

Hence, the correct answer is '**2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**It is given in the question that we have to check only in the** forward direction **

 

So, there are two such pairs in alphabetical order (GN) and (RU)

 

ON and LI are not counted as these pairs are in reverse direction, which is prohibited in the question.
